christians-reading-classics.title: Crossing to Safety by Wallace Stegner, with Matt Stewart
christians-reading-classics.description: Wallace Stegner scholar Matt Stewart talks with Nadya Williams about why quiet novels can hit harder than flashy ones and how Crossing to Safety turns friendship, academia, and marriage into real drama. We also ask what makes a classic, how books survive by luck as much as merit, and why long obedience in relationships might be the rarest plot of all.
